english.title: Cause / permit loaded aircraft to land at non customs and excise airport first time after UK arrival
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the commander of an aircraft entering the United Kingdom from a place outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the aircraft to land for the first time after its arrival in the United Kingdom at a place other than a customs and excise airport, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LANDING PLACE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21(1)(b) and (6) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the commander of an aircraft
entering the UK from a place outside the UK
caused / permitted the aircraft to land for the first time after its arrival in the UK
at a place other than a customs and excise airport

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 21(1A) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.provides that this offence shall not apply by virtue only of the fact that the aircraft is carrying goods brought in from a place outside the customs territory of the European Union.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the commander of an aircraft entering the United Kingdom from a place outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the aircraft to land, at a time while it was carrying passengers or goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), brought in that aircraft from a place outside the United Kingdom and not yet cleared, at a place other than a customs and excise airport, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LANDING PLACE..).
